title: Integrated Clinical Evaluation of Biomarkers, Radiogenomics, and Genomics in Prostate Cancer
official: ICEBERG-PC: Integrated Clinical Evaluation of Biomarkers, Radiogenomics, and Genomics in Prostate Cancer: A Single-Site AmbidirectionalObservational Outcomes Cohort
summary: Management of prostate cancer increasingly integrates conventional clinicopathologic risk factors with multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging (mpMRI), targeted and systematic biopsy, molecular imaging, and selected tissue-based genomic biomarkers. Contemporary guidelines emphasize risk-adapted shared decision-making and allow selective use of tissue-based genomic biomarkers when additional risk stratification may alter management discussions.

interventions.name: The central rationale is to create a source-controlled, longitudinal prostate cancer outcomes cohort in which routine-care genomics, PSMA PET, mpMRI, MRI/ultrasound fusion biopsy, pathology, treatment

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥18 years.
* Diagnosis of prostate cancer documented in the institutional medical record. Prostate adenocarcinoma will constitute the principal analytic population, while other prostate cancer histology's may be retained for descriptive background analyses when clinically relevant.
* Evaluation, diagnosis, treatment, or follow-up within or beyond Advocate Health Wake Forest Baptist / Wake Forest University School of Medicine and availability of sufficient clinical information for at least one study objective.
* For the prospective component, first ascertainment after protocol activation will be conducted through routine clinical records or institutional clinical data systems.
* For the historical background component, available institutional records predating protocol activation will be used to characterize prostate cancer presentation, management, and outcomes

Exclusion Criteria:

* Insufficient clinical information to establish the relevant diagnosis, treatment, or outcome for a proposed analysis.
* Records that cannot be used under applicable institutional privacy, data-governance, or IRB requirements.
